method.description: Extract names explicitly associated with a family relationship, then match them against all local people aliases and collapse matches by canonical person id.
limitations: Claims with no explicit relation target remain in a manual-review list because free-text name extraction is intentionally conservative.
A name shared by multiple canonical people is never resolved automatically.
No relationship rows are written by this report.
